QF.id: SIA Social Impact Assessment and Assessors_20

question.text: Who issues the Social Impact Assessment Standards (SAS) that SIAs must follow when assessing SEs listed on the Social Stock Exchange?

answer.text: Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI)
Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)

explanation.text: The Logic: Workbook p.118 (Section 5.4) states that SIASs and SASs are the area-specific thematic Social Impact Assessment Standards issued by the Institute of Chartered Accountants of India (ICAI). ICAI is the issuing body for the SAS framework that SIAs apply to SSE-listed engagements. The Trap: SEBI (A) regulates the overall SSE framework but does not itself issue the SAS standards. NISM (B) administers the SIA certification examination, not the SAS standard-setting. ICMAI (D) is for cost audit and is a common distractor. Note: The workbook attributes SAS/SIAS issuance directly to ICAI on p.118. Cite ICAI as the issuer in engagement letters and report references.
